006ceab79a.speaker: villager_m2
006ceab79a.text: Somebody left a hare on the Pawlak step again.

009d02c15d.speaker: dobra
009d02c15d.text: You won't. They never are. Hand me that. No, the long one.

00a9864e42.speaker: miller_wife
00a9864e42.text: The herders. They hear it and they go over. I don't know how it works. I only held the lamp.

00c881e1d2.speaker: villager_m1
00c881e1d2.text: He'll keep till the thaw. Can't dig in this.

00e9475830.speaker: bogdan
00e9475830.text: Out past the shelf you get bream, and burbot if you stay after dark. Burbot lies on the bottom. Pike you get at first light or at dusk, and you'll know it when you have one.

014d33035c.speaker: vesna
014d33035c.text: Where did the three go out from?

0152c6da87.speaker: wojtek
0152c6da87.text: That's the week's wages. All of them.

015716ba8a.speaker: villager_m1
015716ba8a.text: Hunter. We've nothing to pay you with, you know.

018d90d61a.speaker: ola
018d90d61a.text: If you look back she gets you!

020321c2f6.speaker: villager_m2
020321c2f6.text: Hunter. We've nothing to pay you with, you know.

02af9e8bb0.speaker: tinker
02af9e8bb0.text: A woman at the foot of the pass makes them. I add a grosz for the carrying.

02c5fe963d.speaker: bogdan
02c5fe963d.text: My father hooked it once. It took forty yards of line and the stick it was tied to. I had it on myself when I was nineteen, most of an hour. Then the line went.

03340494a3.speaker: vesna
03340494a3.text: The paper says before the equinox. What happens then?

03451ead62.speaker: vesna
03451ead62.text: Are you the one who makes the effigies?

034595943e.speaker: vesna
034595943e.text: She asked if her mother sent me.

03ca2bb317.speaker: bogdan
03ca2bb317.text: I don't read the board. I know what's on it.

03ffcf3649.speaker: ola
03ffcf3649.text: Herders. Don't talk, I'll lose it.

0422f157c0.speaker: bogdan
0422f157c0.text: They tell me you were out on the shelf with a rod.

06266b1923.speaker: villager_f1
06266b1923.text: Put your hand down, you will lose a day.

06a00a98c6.speaker: halina
06a00a98c6.text: I'm out. I'll not borrow to play.

06ac5a46f7.speaker: hanka
06ac5a46f7.text: Marta had my arm. I thought it was the torches. You look at torches and then you see things on the ice. Spots.

0735fbb535.speaker: child_f1
0735fbb535.text: If you look back she gets you!

08e94a25d8.speaker: vesna
08e94a25d8.text: The miller's father wouldn't let anyone fish near them. You put your hand in a hole there and it isn't cold like the others.

08edec5e75.speaker: wojtek
08edec5e75.text: That's the week's wages gone. Ask me tomorrow.

094c1a9fc4.speaker: wojtek
094c1a9fc4.text: Not a grosze more. My brother has the rest.

0a1ac8f846.speaker: hanka
0a1ac8f846.text: For the rite. Tomorrow night. They drown a straw Marzanna in the lake, and a girl carries it out to the hole.

0a56b4f004.speaker: vesna
0a56b4f004.text: Roe deer. They pulled it down this morning.

0bb0695b1f.speaker: miller_wife
0bb0695b1f.text: Wipe your feet. I've just done it.

0c8080a824.speaker: zbyszek
0c8080a824.text: Right. Put it on the bar.

0c8bd81565.speaker: miller
0c8bd81565.text: I'll let the boy down to the river tomorrow. Not today.

0e982860ba.speaker: goat_owner
0e982860ba.text: She bites. If you bring her back, there's three eggs, and they're not for anyone else.

0ea4534c21.speaker: dobra
0ea4534c21.text: There's nothing to make. I keep picking up straw anyway.

0ec9303b77.speaker: ola
0ec9303b77.text: Just down. Nobody's got past twenty. I got to eighteen once and Kuba sneezed.

0f076ab41b.speaker: old_woman
0f076ab41b.text: Tall. He stoops. A grey scarf with a red stripe, I knitted it, it's too long, he trips on it.

0ff94047e8.speaker: hanka
0ff94047e8.text: The camp, past the huts, west of the poles. Three holes. Stach had the one nearest the poles.

0ffbe281ac.speaker: ola
0ffbe281ac.text: Then why's she here? It's all ice here.

100370a566.speaker: villager_m3
100370a566.text: Keep the jig high on the shelf. Perch like the top.

102255983b.speaker: vesna
102255983b.text: I rang it at the ring, at dusk. Three times.

108a3de1cd.speaker: zbyszek
108a3de1cd.text: Then it's snow before noon. Don't hang anything out. It's on the page by the door, if you want it in writing.

108e49a90f.speaker: zbyszek
108e49a90f.text: It's thin. I know it's thin. You try brewing with what we've got.

10a7328050.speaker: tinker
10a7328050.text: I've no money to give you. I can sell you a Thaw draught for eight grosze. The tavern asks twelve.

10c61a9c22.speaker: bogdan
10c61a9c22.text: You've still got my hundred. The pass was open this morning.

10da3a74b2.speaker: bogdan
10da3a74b2.text: It's no business of mine. What comes up goes in the stores, and I'll buy what you bring.

112615b8fa.speaker: bogdan
112615b8fa.text: Take it down yourself. Mind the tip, Jarek spliced it.

12355ed2a3.speaker: zbyszek
12355ed2a3.text: Stach was fifty-odd, with a bad knee and a good net. Bolek was younger. Bolek owes me eleven grosze. Owed. I only say it because I wrote it down.

1287d5dc10.speaker: tinker
1287d5dc10.text: The runner split at the knee. It went on the pass, I felt it go, and I've been dragging it since. I've rope and a mallet and I haven't got a third hand.

12b9e34789.speaker: sled_boy
12b9e34789.text: I have to get this home.

12f8a968a9.speaker: fisher_young
12f8a968a9.text: The fish come where the river comes in. There's no sense cutting a hole where there's nothing.

130b950d29.speaker: miller
130b950d29.text: They go in at dawn. I hear them.

13323ea339.speaker: villager_m1
13323ea339.text: Somebody found Zofia's goat in the twisted pines, past the marsh.

134e2b242e.speaker: villager_f2
134e2b242e.text: They're sitting over the roofs again. It'll snow on somebody's yard.

13e4ef3590.speaker: villager_f1
13e4ef3590.text: They're down low. The well will freeze.

15ac58d440.speaker: miller_wife
15ac58d440.text: Leave the bell where it is. Somebody will want it again.

16b9b37493.speaker: vesna
16b9b37493.text: What do they do with her tomorrow night?

16dc65fa5f.speaker: zbyszek
16dc65fa5f.text: Shut the door behind you, you're letting the heat out.

17de5c0c92.speaker: zbyszek
17de5c0c92.text: Not another one. Bogdan counts the till.

18739b6e6c.speaker: villager_f2
18739b6e6c.text: Have you seen the tinker's spoons? They're not bad.

18a5f1ee46.speaker: halina
18a5f1ee46.text: Two grosze a round, if you want it, and six at the most. I've flour to buy at the end of the month.

18bc795506.speaker: vesna
18bc795506.text: How old is it, the rite?

1aa729f82d.speaker: halina
1aa729f82d.text: The one who's raised against can fold. I've done it. I'll do it again.

1acb3fdb20.speaker: villager_m1
1acb3fdb20.text: Put your hand down, you will lose a day.

1b28b98de2.speaker: villager_f1
1b28b98de2.text: Wind is from the pass again.

1c08bff674.speaker: villager_m3
1c08bff674.text: Somebody cleared the wolves off the forest track.

1c43c0dddd.speaker: wojtek
1c43c0dddd.text: Don't lean on the table, it's got a wobble.

1cb63a3f44.speaker: halina
1cb63a3f44.text: You heard Wojtek. I play quieter.

1d2c66cedc.speaker: miller_wife
1d2c66cedc.text: I let them out into the yard this morning. They came back in covered in snow and I could have kissed them.

1d4ad28c7f.speaker: halina
1d4ad28c7f.text: Sit, then. Put it down where I can see it.

1f199eb2c5.speaker: miller_wife
1f199eb2c5.text: Gniewko's father had a hand-bell. Brass, about so big.

1f42dac4f1.speaker: vesna
1f42dac4f1.text: She goes where I go. She doesn't like it.

205cf73611.speaker: villager_m3
205cf73611.text: Not one up since dawn. Snow by noon.

2104888719.speaker: miller
2104888719.text: She stands at the willows and watches the house.

223ec6d855.speaker: tinker
223ec6d855.text: I'll be by the stalls in the square, mornings, when it isn't snowing.

228c979821.speaker: jarek
228c979821.text: I went. Twice. I got as far as the huts and my feet wouldn't go.

228f8179e2.speaker: villager_f2
228f8179e2.text: Zofia's goat came home on a rope.

2350584f17.speaker: bogdan
2350584f17.text: The elders. Pawlak, Rybak, the old women. It isn't a thing I decided.

235c14c27c.speaker: bogdan
235c14c27c.text: At half a measure? Five weeks. Less, if anyone else comes over the pass.

242e7017f3.speaker: ola
242e7017f3.text: A Marzanna. A little one, for the little ones. Dobra does the big one.

243bf32dd5.speaker: villager_f2
243bf32dd5.text: When did you last see grass?

24481a914c.speaker: goat_owner
24481a914c.text: Jan was right, then. He'll be unbearable.

24c573bcf2.speaker: miller_wife
24c573bcf2.text: On the line, on the step I've just swept. Gniewko says it's the same snow wherever it lands.

24cd0888c1.speaker: villager_m1
24cd0888c1.text: Hear that? No. Nothing. Go on.

24ea73cddb.speaker: bogdan
24ea73cddb.text: There's one on the beam over the hearth. It was my father's. Nobody's lit that hearth since October.

25152716f7.speaker: bogdan
25152716f7.text: I don't know why I counted.

2531458734.speaker: villager_m1
2531458734.text: Jan's been unbearable since the goat. He said she'd be under the pines.

2761e22fc7.speaker: vesna
2761e22fc7.text: Why not take it out there yourself?

27cc7768bd.speaker: hanka
27cc7768bd.text: A woman came round with a red ribbon. She measured Ola's wrists with it.

27ec6f0848.speaker: vesna
27ec6f0848.text: What bites out there, and where?

27ef0b012d.speaker: fisher_old
27ef0b012d.text: He's cut it too close to mine. I told him.

2802cf81ec.speaker: villager_m1
2802cf81ec.text: Didn't see one this morning. I'm taking the washing in.

2814666991.speaker: vesna
2814666991.text: You have a lot of company over the yard.

28582a4758.speaker: ola
28582a4758.text: Kuba says if you get past twenty one comes down.

28c45ec6e8.speaker: bogdan
28c45ec6e8.text: There's a hundred and eighty-six of us. You can do sums.

2910ecbf82.speaker: villager_m2
2910ecbf82.text: A grosz a pot. He mended mine in the time it took to say it.

29123cc65f.speaker: wojtek
29123cc65f.text: Three grosze a round and up. Best of three. You in?

29b7046970.speaker: hanka
29b7046970.text: I'll be on the ice tonight. Whatever you do.

2af95632a9.speaker: bogdan
2af95632a9.text: Twenty kilos. More. I've seen it come up under the ice in the dark, a shape as long as that bench.

2b13b02a31.speaker: villager_m1
2b13b02a31.text: They're sitting over the roofs again. It'll snow on somebody's yard.

2b1b72ad2b.speaker: zbyszek
2b1b72ad2b.text: That's for Bogdan. He's the one with the sums.

2b90da1202.speaker: villager_m1
2b90da1202.text: Three sacks of rye left. Three.

2c7a48f09b.speaker: child_m1
2c7a48f09b.text: If you look back she gets you!

2d27fa4553.speaker: villager_f2
2d27fa4553.text: Hunter. We've nothing to pay you with, you know.

2d431b13a1.speaker: old_woman
2d431b13a1.text: That's mine. I bought the wool off the Kowal woman.

2d9b31a2bc.speaker: goat_owner
2d9b31a2bc.text: Three eggs, as I said. I'll not have it said I didn't pay.

2e9d5ce38b.speaker: dobra
2e9d5ce38b.text: Every year I make her and every year they drown her. My mother made them before me.

2ea7e137a8.speaker: child_f1
2ea7e137a8.text: There's a pink one! There's a pink one!

2ebb52377e.speaker: villager_m1
2ebb52377e.text: When did you last see grass?

2ff140d429.speaker: miller_wife
2ff140d429.text: Every spring it would hail on the blossom, and he took it out to the ring on the last of the ice at dusk and rang it three times. They turned it off the orchard.

308aceac37.speaker: jarek
308aceac37.text: I was drunk. I was drunk the night they cut the hole.

30d17f6ef4.speaker: zbyszek
30d17f6ef4.text: Then it's clear. No snow, hard frost by morning. Bring your water in or it'll split the barrel. It's on the page by the door, if you want it in writing.

3101810bee.speaker: miller_wife
3101810bee.text: His mother would have been out with the bell by now.

31c35e2e7f.speaker: wojtek
31c35e2e7f.text: I've nothing left but the axe.

3258ad173b.speaker: vesna
3258ad173b.text: A lot of lights are sitting over your wheel.

32d99ce451.speaker: jarek
32d99ce451.text: Maybe I cut it in the wrong place. Maybe the ice was thin because of me.

335d95adee.speaker: vesna
335d95adee.text: I need a rod. For the ice.

33cf10d693.speaker: zbyszek
33cf10d693.text: Three winters. I had onions behind the house. I've still got the box.

33f37643e2.speaker: bogdan
33f37643e2.text: Somebody said you were standing at a hole with nothing in your hands.

3443d20be5.speaker: fisher_old
3443d20be5.text: You. Hunter. You've no stake in it. Say whose it is.

345323d7a4.speaker: dobra
345323d7a4.text: Then he came out. He was hungry.

34ff5d00fd.speaker: vesna
34ff5d00fd.text: There were hooks in its jaw. Three. One still had line on it, tied with red wool.

354a5fa76a.speaker: halina
354a5fa76a.text: You had the luck, that's all. Sit, if you like.

356b87b5b4.speaker: hanka
356b87b5b4.text: Pull the door hard, it sticks.

36b7486651.speaker: miller
36b7486651.text: They sit there and then it snows in the yard. My wife will tell you.

37afa5257d.speaker: miller
37afa5257d.text: He went down to the river for water. They can all go down, they take turns, I let him go alone.

3842aeb8e3.speaker: villager_m3
3842aeb8e3.text: Can't see a single herder. I'm going home.

384908da1a.speaker: hanka
384908da1a.text: That's what they say. I don't go out after dark.

3870753d93.speaker: villager_f2
3870753d93.text: The old woman still takes her milk out to the shrine every morning.

38d6389af6.speaker: zbyszek
38d6389af6.text: I'm not charging for yesterday's. Sit by the stove.

38e2672690.speaker: zbyszek
38e2672690.text: These were my father's. Bone, the pips cut deep. They roll true.

39f599cdb1.speaker: villager_m1
39f599cdb1.text: A grosz a pot. He mended mine in the time it took to say it.

3ae7530fef.speaker: vesna
3ae7530fef.text: It's on the table, at the top of the tower.

3bf1b99dc4.speaker: hanka
3bf1b99dc4.text: Take it. It's what I've got.

3c282aa0da.speaker: halina
3c282aa0da.text: I've put out what I brought. Ask me tomorrow.

3e62e8ba75.speaker: villager_f2
3e62e8ba75.text: The Wrona girl had hare for her supper. Nobody knows whose it was.

3ea5772378.speaker: villager_f1
3ea5772378.text: Didn't see one this morning. I'm taking the washing in.

3ede5454f3.speaker: hanka
3ede5454f3.text: Ola's at the hill. I let her go.

3f0a352cd4.speaker: hanka
3f0a352cd4.text: On the hill with the others. I said back by dark.

3f232cee30.speaker: villager_f1
3f232cee30.text: The old woman still takes her milk out to the shrine every morning.

3fa2be5fff.speaker: hanka
3fa2be5fff.text: I left it long. She'll grow into it.

4049070564.speaker: hanka
4049070564.text: I know. I know it is.

40e66ffd79.speaker: halina
40e66ffd79.text: Four grosze on you, at least. I don't take promises.

41127348c0.speaker: villager_f1
41127348c0.text: Did you hear it last night? Out on the lake?

4132c9ead6.speaker: zbyszek
4132c9ead6.text: I didn't have anything to say to that.

415f4e903a.speaker: goat_owner
415f4e903a.text: She won't leave my side now. Jan wants to mend the fence. He's wanted to mend the fence since the autumn.

4343216141.speaker: fisher_old
4343216141.text: Mind the slush. It goes in the hole.

43464e935c.speaker: vesna
43464e935c.text: I'll be at the shore at dark.

442421c60d.speaker: zbyszek
442421c60d.text: H.? Only Hanka writes that fair. Her man was the scribe before the fever took him.

44cec850e5.speaker: villager_m2
44cec850e5.text: When did you last see grass?

4560be5114.speaker: vesna
4560be5114.text: Hanka's older girl. Wiesia. Did you know her?

479c17ba60.speaker: villager_m3
479c17ba60.text: Low tonight. No snow by morning.

480b081b90.speaker: dobra
480b081b90.text: A hunter came through. One of yours. Lynx. We had nothing to give him.

48267e7874.speaker: bogdan
48267e7874.text: I'm the reeve. I count the grain.

48a96dd13f.speaker: vesna
48a96dd13f.text: And before the equinox, it says.

49578dc48d.speaker: vesna
49578dc48d.text: The paper says to ask at the shore.

49d0473e3e.speaker: wojtek
49d0473e3e.text: That was me. Halina says I throw them like I'm splitting wood.

49f42665f8.speaker: bogdan
49f42665f8.text: You have nothing to do till tomorrow night. And nobody here has the evenings.

4a88c3bf3f.speaker: villager_m2
4a88c3bf3f.text: Somebody cleared the wolves off the forest track.

4b15a22d8a.speaker: villager_m2
4b15a22d8a.text: Three sacks of rye left. Three.

4bce309c36.speaker: old_woman
4bce309c36.text: My Jasiek went up four days ago with the sledge, for wood. He's sixteen. I put the milk here for him, in case he comes by this way. It's no use to the shrine.

4d38485768.speaker: fisher_young
4d38485768.text: He says my hole's too close to his. I say that's where the fish are.

4d6098909d.speaker: zbyszek
4d6098909d.text: You've been down at Hanka's already. Somebody saw you go in.

4d6c29ed91.speaker: zbyszek
4d6c29ed91.text: We've done it three years running. Look outside.

4de9b06564.speaker: wojtek
4de9b06564.text: Hm. You didn't even blink. Take it.

4e1d5d20c3.speaker: vesna
4e1d5d20c3.text: You don't know that it was you.

4e965438db.speaker: dobra
4e965438db.text: In the morning. I have more hands in the morning.

4f07d6b017.speaker: vesna
4f07d6b017.text: A hand-bell tied to the pole, a rag round the clapper.

4f725fdf5b.speaker: zbyszek
4f725fdf5b.text: He goes out there every day anyway. I'll tell his wife. After the rite.

4fabfe7f85.speaker: villager_f2
4fabfe7f85.text: There's a scarf tied to the milk shrine on the pass road. Nobody's touched it.

4ff6515785.speaker: bogdan
4ff6515785.text: I'll put it in the book.

51034b2c00.speaker: fisher_old
51034b2c00.text: Nothing since dawn. They won't bite when it's clear.

5104b160cf.speaker: vesna
5104b160cf.text: Is that all it is worth to you?

51265beac0.speaker: villager_m1
51265beac0.text: Zofia's goat came home on a rope.

523e03282b.speaker: goat_owner
523e03282b.text: You came down the pass road. Did you see a goat? White, one ear folded over.

525b913291.speaker: zbyszek
525b913291.text: Not a herder up all day. That's snow by dark, you watch.

540834e1d0.speaker: dobra
540834e1d0.text: Too tight, it'll snap. Like that.

5475504278.speaker: dobra
5475504278.text: Took half the night, some nights.

5479469054.speaker: vesna
5479469054.text: I saw a cart on the pass. A man, a woman, a girl.

5491e201a2.speaker: dobra
5491e201a2.text: She's never once looked down. Not in my time, not in my mother's.

549a2f0b83.speaker: villager_f1
549a2f0b83.text: Three sacks of rye left. Three.

54b0b9df46.speaker: villager_f2
54b0b9df46.text: Put your hand down. Not at them.

54ff5bf7a0.speaker: miller
54ff5bf7a0.text: Forty grosze. I'd say more. The wheel's been frozen two winters, I grind by hand what people bring, and nobody brings anything.

5578a9da50.speaker: zbyszek
5578a9da50.text: She keeps to herself. House on the shore, east, past the huts. There's a bowl of milk by the door, you can't miss it. Don't ask her about the milk.

564a51d2f9.speaker: bogdan
564a51d2f9.text: I've nothing for you. I'm counting torches.

5681364bec.speaker: hanka
5681364bec.text: Go and bring the wood in.

56a020cbe3.speaker: zbyszek
56a020cbe3.text: That one's mine. The next is a grosze.

571af07bad.speaker: miller_wife
571af07bad.text: Soup's on, if you want it. Still turnip.

57204bc0fc.speaker: zbyszek
57204bc0fc.text: Ask the reeve. It's not my business and I'm not saying it.

5752960ef0.speaker: zbyszek
5752960ef0.text: It's a long way out and a long way back and it's cold. You sing loud.

57e4391ac7.speaker: vesna
57e4391ac7.text: The paper says something walks the ice.

581a81e585.speaker: villager_m3
581a81e585.text: Not today. Come back when it is cooler.

584330c387.speaker: zbyszek
584330c387.text: And the Wrona boy, seventeen. That's his father you'll see at the holes.

58faf46b43.speaker: tinker
58faf46b43.text: Keep to that side. It's resting on the one runner and I don't trust it.

59bb4caad7.speaker: bogdan
59bb4caad7.text: I want it on a table. That's a week for Pawlak's house and the Nowaks and half the shelf.

5a93ded221.speaker: villager_f1
5a93ded221.text: The tinker is back at the stalls. Three years.

5aa458cab7.speaker: ola
5aa458cab7.text: It's for Wiesia. She's dead. She can't drink it.

5bf9686a93.speaker: miller_wife
5bf9686a93.text: Kill them, and you can have whatever is in the pot.

5c06b61382.speaker: bogdan
5c06b61382.text: Stach had four at home. Pawlak's taken them on her share, and Pawlak's a widow. That's seven mouths on one share, if you want it plain.

5c1ae02f73.speaker: zbyszek
5c1ae02f73.text: Don't. Not today. If he knows he'll want to go out there.

5c36be15ce.speaker: zbyszek
5c36be15ce.text: There's a barrel in the cellar I put by the first winter. For when it ended. It'll have turned by now.

5d942c6607.speaker: vesna
5d942c6607.text: Gniewko the miller says his father wouldn't let anyone fish by the poles. Warm water comes up there.

5df07509bb.speaker: vesna
5df07509bb.text: I didn't find anything else. It had snowed over everything.

5e2aa00076.speaker: villager_m3
5e2aa00076.text: Ice is thick here. Thick as my head.

5e457ce85b.speaker: dobra
5e457ce85b.text: She'd only go home and think about it.

5ec0ce8a7d.speaker: dobra
5ec0ce8a7d.text: Bogdan's been out to look at those stones. Twice this winter.

5f7f9c78e0.speaker: vesna
5f7f9c78e0.text: I'll go out when it's dark.

5f8fbfb51c.speaker: villager_m1
5f8fbfb51c.text: Bogdan went out to the crossroads.

5fadcaace6.speaker: zbyszek
5fadcaace6.text: Everybody goes. I carry a torch. It's my turn. It's been my turn every year, I don't know how that works.

5fee0303c6.speaker: villager_m2
5fee0303c6.text: He'll keep till the thaw. Can't dig in this.

60fc6511a7.speaker: child_m1
60fc6511a7.text: There's a pink one! There's a pink one!

60fee1d4ca.speaker: vesna
60fee1d4ca.text: I came over the pass. There was a cart on the road. A man, a woman, a small girl.

610f7e7233.speaker: vesna
610f7e7233.text: I saw what happened. Three years ago.

626d91eb98.speaker: bogdan
626d91eb98.text: The first of it goes to Pawlak's. She has seven at the table.

626e7791eb.speaker: bogdan
626e7791eb.text: It's always cut there. My father cut it there.

63cdf97c22.speaker: sled_boy
63cdf97c22.text: It's not stuck. It's just stopped.

646f84635c.speaker: villager_m2
646f84635c.text: Somebody found Zofia's goat in the twisted pines, past the marsh.

66b3dd2c35.speaker: villager_m2
66b3dd2c35.text: Hear that? No. Nothing. Go on.

67d5587142.speaker: bogdan
67d5587142.text: Tomorrow night we do the rite, and that's the end of it.

681d86b9dc.speaker: bogdan
681d86b9dc.text: It will snow. It always snows.

687f9abf80.speaker: hanka
687f9abf80.text: It's nothing. It freezes by morning anyway.

68c3226e8a.speaker: villager_m2
68c3226e8a.text: Put your hand down, you will lose a day.

692e4056b7.speaker: bogdan
692e4056b7.text: Tomorrow night's the equinox. We carry a straw woman out to the poles and put her through the ice, the way it's always done. And that's the end of it.

6b2ac0ef66.speaker: villager_f1
6b2ac0ef66.text: Hear that? No. Nothing. Go on.

6bf7ea0d17.speaker: vesna
6bf7ea0d17.text: There's ice enough for two. Cut another a few paces over.

6c502a1f7e.speaker: miller_wife
6c502a1f7e.text: There's soup. It's turnip, I'm sorry. It was turnip yesterday.

6c5042fe50.speaker: vesna
6c5042fe50.text: It was on the pass road, past the sledge. By itself.

6d661dfcfb.speaker: zbyszek
6d661dfcfb.text: Hear that? The roof. It hasn't stopped dripping since morning. I've buckets on every floor.

6d99f1d4c4.speaker: dobra
6d99f1d4c4.text: Torches, and a pole, and the hair isn't done. Don't stand there.

6de5923f0c.speaker: vesna
6de5923f0c.text: Your mother puts a bowl of milk out at the door.

6e46c6b109.speaker: miller_wife
6e46c6b109.text: He did. He won't say it, but he hasn't slept.

6e5a50a6c6.speaker: bogdan
6e5a50a6c6.text: I told you to get out.

6f1d3ac154.speaker: hanka
6f1d3ac154.text: It's too long. She'll catch her heel on it.

6f2d30a1c1.speaker: miller_wife
6f2d30a1c1.text: Dusk, mind. Not before. Three times, and not a fourth.

6f402d65bf.speaker: vesna
6f402d65bf.text: Is there anything you need done?

6f4afad27f.speaker: villager_m1
6f4afad27f.text: The Wrona girl had hare for her supper. Nobody knows whose it was.

6fe4f80236.speaker: zbyszek
6fe4f80236.text: Then come back when you have. I'd give it to you. I can't, they'd all want it.

6fe545b245.speaker: jarek
6fe545b245.text: I gave her a scarf once. She said it itched. She wore it all the same.

701248b51a.speaker: vesna
701248b51a.text: Same as the one at the toll house.

714ba051f4.speaker: wojtek
714ba051f4.text: Throw them again. They've gone cold.

7259000392.speaker: villager_m3
7259000392.text: Wacław's keeping his hole at the river mouth. The young one's gone to the shallows.

731136b24d.speaker: bogdan
731136b24d.text: I looked at the lake this morning. Not one herder up. That's snow by dark, and the torches won't like it.

7330838793.speaker: villager_m2
7330838793.text: There's a scarf tied to the milk shrine on the pass road. Nobody's touched it.

73e75a31af.speaker: dobra
73e75a31af.text: Older than me. There's old stones out on the island with pictures cut in them.

73e76cba0c.speaker: miller
73e76cba0c.text: On the board in the square. Wolves.

7411f21055.speaker: dobra
7411f21055.text: My boy, when he was little, he'd get under the bed when it thundered. You couldn't pull him out. You had to sit on the floor and wait.

745b7d090e.speaker: villager_m2
745b7d090e.text: Did you hear it last night? Out on the lake?

74c4c0011b.speaker: bogdan
74c4c0011b.text: I'll pay by the kilo, like anything else.

74dc35e39a.speaker: dobra
74dc35e39a.text: Mind the straw on your way out.

753e539156.speaker: wojtek
753e539156.text: Pair, two pairs, three the same, then a run, three and a pair, four the same, five. Higher dice win a tie.

755979b132.speaker: vesna
755979b132.text: I was at the poles tonight. I saw it.

76d8a451ad.speaker: dobra
76d8a451ad.text: You walk her out, you burn her, in she goes, you walk back singing. You don't turn round. That's all there is to it.

78b07aade5.speaker: tinker
78b07aade5.text: You've three on you already. Come back when you've used one.

78e71da311.speaker: villager_f2
78e71da311.text: Somebody found Zofia's goat in the twisted pines, past the marsh.

78fd26b146.speaker: ola
78fd26b146.text: Everybody knows it. You know it.

793738ae7a.speaker: hanka
793738ae7a.text: Is there anything else you need to know?

796b0e9e5e.speaker: vesna
796b0e9e5e.text: For a bit. Then it doesn't.

79ac281702.speaker: vesna
79ac281702.text: What do you do with it?

7a40d5edcf.speaker: bogdan
7a40d5edcf.text: Sixty. I need eighty. Dobra has the girls making them.

7a671ae6e6.speaker: villager_f2
7a671ae6e6.text: Three sacks of rye left. Three.

7b65208572.speaker: vesna
7b65208572.text: I wasn't going to say anything.

7b8e4a09a7.speaker: jarek
7b8e4a09a7.text: You're going out there. To her.

7c1944ecc8.speaker: villager_m1
7c1944ecc8.text: Somebody left a hare on the Pawlak step again.

7c358b4003.speaker: miller_wife
7c358b4003.text: It's been out there two years.

7c5b5fbb5a.speaker: dobra
7c5b5fbb5a.text: Next year's. I'll start in the autumn.

7c91d9b887.speaker: vesna
7c91d9b887.text: This was nailed up at the toll house below the pass. Three men, it says.

7d1b42543b.speaker: zbyszek
7d1b42543b.text: The girl's picked, anyway. Last week.

7d774ff86e.speaker: vesna
7d774ff86e.text: Tell me how the rite goes.

7d8f6a6f38.speaker: wojtek
7d8f6a6f38.text: Not tonight. Everybody's going down to the shore.

7dfd19cd61.speaker: child_m1
7dfd19cd61.text: Don't talk to me, I'm at seventeen.

7e3911bbd9.speaker: villager_m2
7e3911bbd9.text: The tinker is back at the stalls. Three years.

7ee5baa4bd.speaker: vesna
7ee5baa4bd.text: I have a horse, if you want to see her.

7f0e2d379b.speaker: zbyszek
7f0e2d379b.text: Clear tonight. Everything in the yard will freeze and I will be told it was my fault.

7f20b1addd.speaker: zbyszek
7f20b1addd.text: It was snowing, you couldn't see the one beside you.

7f34baf1b3.speaker: bogdan
7f34baf1b3.text: On the shelf in front of the huts it's perch and roach. Midday, high in the water. Children's fish.

7fb59e258d.speaker: villager_f1
7fb59e258d.text: He'll keep till the thaw. Can't dig in this.

80074d0c4a.speaker: bogdan
80074d0c4a.text: It's a deep lake. I'm not sending a man out to look for three men I've already lost.

8011b190ad.speaker: villager_f1
8011b190ad.text: Somebody left a hare on the Pawlak step again.

802a0302ad.speaker: fisher_old
802a0302ad.text: Your line is in my hole.

8046f414e1.speaker: zbyszek
8046f414e1.text: Old Wrona goes out to the holes every morning. Sits there till dark.

806c7bfff7.speaker: miller
806c7bfff7.text: The boy's been down to the river twice. He took the dog's bowl with him.

810ff5c5a5.speaker: bogdan
810ff5c5a5.text: Go on a clear night, when they're low over the lake. They bite then. All of them.

81393abce6.speaker: halina
81393abce6.text: Five dice each, and you may roll any of them again, once. After the first throw anyone can raise. Once.

81d681821b.speaker: vesna
81d681821b.text: Something very big goes round the valley. High up, with lights in it.

82603d0756.speaker: villager_m2
82603d0756.text: Have you got any tallow? I'll give you eggs. Well. One egg.

82c06ffcd1.speaker: wojtek
82c06ffcd1.text: You again. I'm not done being angry about last time.

843e008c22.speaker: villager_m1
843e008c22.text: The tinker is back at the stalls. Three years.

84e6ff0fa3.speaker: vesna
84e6ff0fa3.text: I was at the poles last night. I saw it.

864dcfb77d.speaker: villager_m2
864dcfb77d.text: Didn't see one this morning. I'm taking the washing in.

8680624cf8.speaker: zbyszek
8680624cf8.text: That's the float. I'm not touching the rest.

86c7124a56.speaker: villager_m2
86c7124a56.text: Put your hand down. Not at them.

87764008ab.speaker: villager_m1
87764008ab.text: Wojtek says the forest track's quiet at dusk now.

87e34f9234.speaker: fisher_young
87e34f9234.text: And I've been on it since before light. My line's in it.

8800523e62.speaker: wojtek
8800523e62.text: Five dice each. You throw all five, you look, you pick the ones you don't like and throw those again. Once.

88d8cfbfe9.speaker: villager_f1
88d8cfbfe9.text: Agnieszka took bread out to the crossroads this morning.

8956f5d483.speaker: hanka
8956f5d483.text: I take milk down every night. She liked it warm. I can't get it out there warm.

89d1db3e14.speaker: vesna
89d1db3e14.text: He had a letter on him. Tomasz.

8a5a8f99fb.speaker: jarek
8a5a8f99fb.text: Out by the old tower, where the bell is. That's where she'd be, I think.

8a9f0e5fb5.speaker: vesna
8a9f0e5fb5.text: It wasn't you. Warm water comes up under the poles.

8aa8684717.speaker: goat_owner
8aa8684717.text: She was through the fence yesterday. The wind drops it. She's never gone far, but there's nothing to eat out here and she'll have gone looking.

8ac1720e9a.speaker: fisher_young
8ac1720e9a.text: I'll cut it where I like.

8b6c4f94d4.speaker: miller_wife
8b6c4f94d4.text: Inside. They've been inside for six days. They fight.

8b8e9f0fd5.speaker: zbyszek
8b8e9f0fd5.text: In the line. Near the back, with the torches.

8baee73532.speaker: dobra
8baee73532.text: By the door. You'll be out of my light.

8c555cf79e.speaker: villager_f1
8c555cf79e.text: Hunter. We've nothing to pay you with, you know.

8d5212acc5.speaker: halina
8d5212acc5.text: I haven't got more with me.

8da03cd5bb.speaker: halina
8da03cd5bb.text: Mind where you sit. That end's Wojtek's.

8db79b952b.speaker: zbyszek
8db79b952b.text: Put it there, by the till.

8e00a75921.speaker: old_woman
8e00a75921.text: I'll put it up on the post. He'll see it from the road.

8e628a6d1c.speaker: vesna
8e628a6d1c.text: I'll leave it where she'll find it.

8e6e1cb633.speaker: miller
8e6e1cb633.text: I don't know. It doesn't turn. There's nothing in it for them.

8e7c30346c.speaker: hanka
8e7c30346c.text: She'll be back before dark. She's been told.

8e947fb4c3.speaker: dobra
8e947fb4c3.text: Mine. I tie every one. Why, did they come undone?

90174671ea.speaker: tinker
90174671ea.text: Pots mended, spoons, kettles. Thaw draught, eight grosze.

902967647c.speaker: villager_f1
902967647c.text: Have you seen the tinker's spoons? They're not bad.

902bd02105.speaker: villager_m3
902bd02105.text: Low and many. Bring your water in.

909b95a84d.speaker: miller
909b95a84d.text: Burek went with him. Burek went between. I heard him, and then I didn't.

91aa66f8b7.speaker: sled_boy
91aa66f8b7.text: You're the hunter. Ola says your eyes are just yellow.

9206128a74.speaker: miller
9206128a74.text: The old ones know. Most of them are dead.

92effddad7.speaker: sled_boy
92effddad7.text: It's still stuck. I mean stopped.

930d4e51f9.speaker: wojtek
930d4e51f9.text: Sit, then. Put your coin where I can see it.

9322da430d.speaker: vesna
9322da430d.text: I found your three. They're under the ice, out by the old tower.

9350629935.speaker: zbyszek
9350629935.text: Wipe your boots, I've done the floor twice.

938e59e04d.speaker: bogdan
938e59e04d.text: Everybody knows not to fish there.

93a65dcee5.speaker: hanka
93a65dcee5.text: By the time I got back there was just slush.

93d1546f69.speaker: villager_m2
93d1546f69.text: Bogdan went out to the crossroads.

9439e83560.speaker: villager_m3
9439e83560.text: Wacław and Franek are fishing the river mouth a few paces apart and not speaking.

94d07cce9f.speaker: villager_f1
94d07cce9f.text: Put your hand down. Not at them.

953eb8263e.speaker: vesna
953eb8263e.text: Who have you been talking to?

9544c249a4.speaker: zbyszek
9544c249a4.text: Kosci. Five dice, best of three. It's chalked up on the beam over the bar, if you can read it.

95a541058d.speaker: bogdan
95a541058d.text: The big ones go to Pawlak's first. She has seven at the table.

96a1e5535f.speaker: villager_m2
96a1e5535f.text: Have you seen the tinker's spoons? They're not bad.

97336813c4.speaker: child_m1
97336813c4.text: Somebody pushed Stas's sled out of the river.

97ac4cf526.speaker: villager_f1
97ac4cf526.text: They're sitting over the roofs again. It'll snow on somebody's yard.

98c06766c5.speaker: tinker
98c06766c5.text: Take the corner by the load. Lift when I say and don't put it down till I've tied it off. It won't take long.

991c3eedee.speaker: sled_boy
991c3eedee.text: I've one grosz. Mama said if anybody helped I was to give them something.

9aeb152632.speaker: tinker
9aeb152632.text: I'm out of the draughts. Pots, spoons, kettles, if you need them.

9af387aebd.speaker: zbyszek
9af387aebd.text: Nobody's paid for it since the autumn, so I'm not asking.

9b212496f9.speaker: zbyszek
9b212496f9.text: And don't point at them in here. I've had a man walk out over it.

9b5da82d22.speaker: ola
9b5da82d22.text: Dobra says she tied good knots.

9bad85dd30.speaker: vesna
9bad85dd30.text: Wiesia didn't just fall in. Her mother saw her in the water, and everyone kept walking.

9c4626847a.speaker: bogdan
9c4626847a.text: You have nothing to do till tonight. And nobody here has the evenings.

9cb2239e4d.speaker: tinker
9cb2239e4d.text: Hunter! Over here, if you have a minute.

9ccc981a93.speaker: vesna
9ccc981a93.text: Hanka's older girl, the one who drowned. Did you know her?

9d32bcec1a.speaker: vesna
9d32bcec1a.text: What have you got for the cold, besides soup?

9d72dfb7a2.speaker: zbyszek
9d72dfb7a2.text: She's eleven. She comes round for the scraps for the goat and I give her a bit extra. Don't tell anyone.

9e4efdf208.speaker: vesna
9e4efdf208.text: We're not going down in this.

9e5245f15f.speaker: ola
9e5245f15f.text: And that you've got cat's eyes.

9e6a484adb.speaker: miller_wife
9e6a484adb.text: He died the second winter. Nobody went for it.

9ea4a426e9.speaker: villager_f2
9ea4a426e9.text: He'll keep till the thaw. Can't dig in this.

9fb8728ff4.speaker: vesna
9fb8728ff4.text: A roe deer. Not much left of it.

a0d7061c57.speaker: bogdan
a0d7061c57.text: And the line, if you have it.

a1051e34d1.speaker: ola
a1051e34d1.text: Kuba said witches go before it gets dark.

a1c07f581e.speaker: bogdan
a1c07f581e.text: I haven't got two hundred. I haven't got a hundred, if I'm honest. Take it or don't.

a20e7ca6e5.speaker: dobra
a20e7ca6e5.text: She helped me one winter. Good hands. Tied a better knot than me by the end. Don't tell her mother I said that.

a24b1c8ad8.speaker: ola
a24b1c8ad8.text: Don't talk to me, I'm at seventeen.

a2bb9ffe6c.speaker: villager_f2
a2bb9ffe6c.text: Agnieszka took bread out to the crossroads this morning.

a2fb90eb79.speaker: villager_f1
a2fb90eb79.text: A grosz a pot. He mended mine in the time it took to say it.

a2fc7e86b1.speaker: vesna
a2fc7e86b1.text: Hanka's girl didn't just fall in. Hanka saw her in the water, and everyone kept walking.

a33da5da9d.speaker: vesna
a33da5da9d.text: Who else knew them? Anyone who would talk?

a3f285abed.speaker: old_woman
a3f285abed.text: You'll want paying. It's eight grosze, it's what's in the jar. I'd rather it went somewhere.

a463b46948.speaker: bogdan
a463b46948.text: It's been open three days. That's all I know about it.

a5ebe69892.speaker: villager_m3
a5ebe69892.text: They've gone high. Cover your nets.

a600660b7a.speaker: dobra
a600660b7a.text: I'm the one making this one. Mind the straw.

a616361280.speaker: hanka
a616361280.text: It doesn't matter which. She was polite about it.

a61c1d41cf.speaker: zbyszek
a61c1d41cf.text: I haven't any more out here.

a6840ae101.speaker: bogdan
a6840ae101.text: Ask the old women, they go by the herders. I've the sacks to count.

a7ae130770.speaker: vesna
a7ae130770.text: Your cap is in that drift.

a8ceff0de6.speaker: villager_m2
a8ceff0de6.text: They're sitting over the roofs again. It'll snow on somebody's yard.

a946f56332.speaker: miller_wife
a946f56332.text: Out at the wheel. If it's about the wolves, he put a paper up in the square. They took our dog. He hasn't slept.

a95e55df62.speaker: vesna
a95e55df62.text: Your husband put up a paper.

aa0ad674b2.speaker: vesna
aa0ad674b2.text: Three in a month. And no bodies.

aa34d716f5.speaker: hanka
aa34d716f5.text: They say the goddess took one from this house, so she'll want the other. That's what they're saying.

aa9a6fa9b8.speaker: villager_f2
aa9a6fa9b8.text: Put your hand down, you will lose a day.

aadfff12f4.speaker: villager_m2
aadfff12f4.text: I'll send the sledge for him when the road's clear.

ab20b31423.speaker: zbyszek
ab20b31423.text: Out past the poles. I wasn't going to go and measure.

ab399d86f8.speaker: zbyszek
ab399d86f8.text: Stach's coat is still on the hook there. His wife hasn't come for it. I can't hang anything else on it.

ab70d5d907.speaker: zbyszek
ab70d5d907.text: Not tonight. I'm shutting at seven, and everyone goes down to the shore.

ab9619c2ef.speaker: vesna
ab9619c2ef.text: She was in the twisted pines, under the trees.

ac44c03e56.speaker: child_f1
ac44c03e56.text: Somebody pushed Stas's sled out of the river.

ad2d8ae5bf.speaker: villager_m3
ad2d8ae5bf.text: Not past the poles. Never past the poles.

ad7acf3c12.speaker: villager_f2
ad7acf3c12.text: They're down low. The well will freeze.

ae7af33206.speaker: dobra
ae7af33206.text: Put it on that pile. No, the other pile.

aea0d8588e.speaker: hanka
aea0d8588e.text: It's all there is in the house.

aefa284d47.speaker: villager_m1
aefa284d47.text: Wind is from the pass again.

af6e5609cb.speaker: zbyszek
af6e5609cb.text: And Jarek went out with Stach. He's in from dark, the corner there. He pays for one and I don't ask about the rest.

afbf45a20b.speaker: villager_m1
afbf45a20b.text: Put your hand down. Not at them.

b0c9b887b2.speaker: halina
b0c9b887b2.text: Put some more down, if you like.

b132df5768.speaker: ola
b132df5768.text: It's stupid. It freezes. I told her.

b1900c100e.speaker: zbyszek
b1900c100e.text: Nothing. Not a pair between them.

b1ce48c7d7.speaker: vesna
b1ce48c7d7.text: Wolves on a kill. They haven't seen me.

b21a44f012.speaker: zbyszek
b21a44f012.text: Not bad. Not bad at all.

b24c1a2d79.speaker: villager_m2
b24c1a2d79.text: Wojtek says the forest track's quiet at dusk now.

b55809115c.speaker: zbyszek
b55809115c.text: Went to their holes at dusk and the holes were empty in the morning. Not even the stools.

b593dd389b.speaker: bogdan
b593dd389b.text: The goddess took one from that house. She's owed the other.

b617cbee8d.speaker: zbyszek
b617cbee8d.text: You look like you've been dragged behind something.

b64e1e54c1.speaker: zbyszek
b64e1e54c1.text: I never won with them. Take them before Wojtek hears about them.

b744661838.speaker: zbyszek
b744661838.text: That you've beaten the three of us.

b78b9f8943.speaker: vesna
b78b9f8943.text: I know. I wanted to look at the shore first.

b7e621add0.speaker: vesna
b7e621add0.text: His name was Wit. He told me he found me in a ditch.

b92dcd5192.speaker: zbyszek
b92dcd5192.text: The rite's tomorrow night. Equinox. We drown Marzanna and the winter goes.

ba4f243401.speaker: fisher_young
ba4f243401.text: It's the river's hole. It's where the water comes in. Anyone can fish where the water comes in.

ba52be003a.speaker: zbyszek
ba52be003a.text: Why's anyone. He's had a bad few years.

bad13ed5b1.speaker: villager_m1
bad13ed5b1.text: Did you hear it last night? Out on the lake?

bba7bed445.speaker: zbyszek
bba7bed445.text: I know that. It's for after.

bbc3387849.speaker: dobra
bbc3387849.text: Not there either, that's the hair.

bc496aa43a.speaker: zbyszek
bc496aa43a.text: Three gone this month. Stach, Bolek, and the younger Wrona.

bcb075430c.speaker: villager_m2
bcb075430c.text: Wind is from the pass again.

bcdd605e48.speaker: villager_f2
bcdd605e48.text: Hear that? No. Nothing. Go on.

bcdeed8c5d.speaker: fisher_young
bcdeed8c5d.text: Of course. It's always the old ones' holes.

bcf35bf257.speaker: zbyszek
bcf35bf257.text: You haven't two grosze to put on the bar.

be1142936f.speaker: zbyszek
be1142936f.text: That's the third man to stand at my window and count them. If you're not drinking, count outside.

be2e653769.speaker: zbyszek
be2e653769.text: Everybody knew them. Old Wrona's by the door most mornings, if you've the stomach.

bec35cbf4c.speaker: miller
bec35cbf4c.text: My father never let anyone fish there. Warm water comes up. The ice is never as thick as it looks.

beced59311.speaker: villager_m3
beced59311.text: Wojtek says the forest track's quiet at dusk now.

bee290347a.speaker: hanka
bee290347a.text: If whatever's out there is dead before tomorrow night, they'll have no reason.

bf653e7836.speaker: vesna
bf653e7836.text: I left the bird where she would see it.

bfdac2307a.speaker: dobra
bfdac2307a.text: There was a winter, before you'd remember anything. We were boiling bark. The wolves came down and got into the graves.

c022096bea.speaker: miller_wife
c022096bea.text: Forty trees behind the house. Plum and apple. Not a leaf on them since the first winter.

c0524ce077.speaker: jarek
c0524ce077.text: Hanka's girl. She went through the ice at the rite.

c05ca3c7c6.speaker: zbyszek
c05ca3c7c6.text: I've been up since four, emptying buckets. Mind the one by the door.

c08d8c90d9.speaker: bogdan
c08d8c90d9.text: I light it when the ink freezes. It hasn't frozen.

c1383fed5a.speaker: bogdan
c1383fed5a.text: We went into the winter with ninety sacks of rye. There are forty-one.

c17594ad5c.speaker: vesna
c17594ad5c.text: Three years ago. At the rite. Where were you?

c1a9684bdc.speaker: miller_wife
c1a9684bdc.text: Twenty grosze for the walk. It's what there is.

c24736fc4c.speaker: vesna
c24736fc4c.text: There is a room at the top of the drowned tower. Seventeen straw figures sitting round a table.

c2aa8ab672.speaker: villager_m2
c2aa8ab672.text: Zofia's goat came home on a rope.

c2b580516c.speaker: tinker
c2b580516c.text: The Drowned Bell. You'll find it, there's only the one. The beer was thin last time.

c3be95f69b.speaker: villager_m1
c3be95f69b.text: Somebody cleared the wolves off the forest track.

c3f1eca98d.speaker: vesna
c3f1eca98d.text: Keep on, girl. There's work on the other side.

c42d3d090a.speaker: miller_wife
c42d3d090a.text: He left it out there the last good spring, tied to a pole so it would be to hand.

c42f02f49d.speaker: ola
c42f02f49d.text: Mama's sewing my dress. It's very white.

c459bb2553.speaker: villager_f2
c459bb2553.text: Wind is from the pass again.

c49b430bf2.speaker: villager_f1
c49b430bf2.text: There's a scarf tied to the milk shrine on the pass road. Nobody's touched it.

c547c67bd0.speaker: zbyszek
c547c67bd0.text: Thaw draughts. Twelve grosze, and before you say anything, I don't set the price.

c5c19f3eb7.speaker: vesna
c5c19f3eb7.text: Only on the ice. She doesn't like it.

c5ce9d7fdf.speaker: tinker
c5ce9d7fdf.text: Pots, kettles, ladles. A hundred and some spoons. If I unload it I only have to load it again, and my back isn't the one I came with.

c5d0465ae1.speaker: ola
c5d0465ae1.text: It's heavy. I have to practise.

c62b876c1c.speaker: miller_wife
c62b876c1c.text: They sit there from noon. Then it snows on the yard. Not on the hill, not on the wheel. The yard.

c671947d95.speaker: vesna
c671947d95.text: How long has it been like this?

c8a1e1ea5e.speaker: miller
c8a1e1ea5e.text: She's dead? The one with the scar?

c8ab0de955.speaker: bogdan
c8ab0de955.text: The offer's still good until the morning. After that I need it for wood.

c905b94bce.speaker: zbyszek
c905b94bce.text: What did you want, a goose?

c9336b160c.speaker: child_f1
c9336b160c.text: Don't talk to me, I'm at seventeen.

c97abdd418.speaker: hanka
c97abdd418.text: She carries the effigy. That's what they say.

ca37719fa7.speaker: zbyszek
ca37719fa7.text: That's out of the till, that is.

ca53973e39.speaker: goat_owner
ca53973e39.text: That's her. That's her, look. Come here. Come here, you stupid animal.

ca72f38c42.speaker: villager_f1
ca72f38c42.text: When did you last see grass?

cada688eee.speaker: ola
cada688eee.text: Nobody. Kuba says it's cold and then you go to sleep.

cb37ea5d36.speaker: villager_f2
cb37ea5d36.text: A grosz a pot. He mended mine in the time it took to say it.

cb4f704a11.speaker: bogdan
cb4f704a11.text: A hundred grosze. The pass will take one rider, if she's careful.

cbae10a3b0.speaker: villager_m2
cbae10a3b0.text: They're down low. The well will freeze.

cc84a6f6a8.speaker: bogdan
cc84a6f6a8.text: And stay off the lake. People go through it.

cd00f0b793.speaker: dobra
cd00f0b793.text: I had a baby I couldn't feed.

cd1a7f1cf1.speaker: miller
cd1a7f1cf1.text: Mind the bank. The ice over the race is bad.

cd8fcec005.speaker: villager_f1
cd8fcec005.text: Jan's been unbearable since the goat. He said she'd be under the pines.

cdfe14b5f7.speaker: vesna
cdfe14b5f7.text: He's got his line in it. It's his for today.

ce5b8d7815.speaker: vesna
ce5b8d7815.text: You won't know till you open it.

ce8dc5d996.speaker: halina
ce8dc5d996.text: I've seen better in the fish baskets.

cea7e468c0.speaker: miller
cea7e468c0.text: There's soup, if you want. My wife made it.

cec6c58562.speaker: bogdan
cec6c58562.text: It was my father's. Horsehair and flax, waxed. I have never let anyone put it in the water.

cf2a33fc41.speaker: dobra
cf2a33fc41.text: He came back. Years after. Asked did I want to know where you were.

cf8be33966.speaker: ola
cf8be33966.text: Are you here for the ice lady?

cfc76d5c21.speaker: zbyszek
cfc76d5c21.text: He came in here and asked about the road. I told him don't. He said Mira wouldn't have another winter. Zosia had a cough.

d04568a606.speaker: zbyszek
d04568a606.text: Across the bar. A grosze, two, three. That's all I put out, it's the till's money, not mine.

d0a8cac30f.speaker: zbyszek
d0a8cac30f.text: Shut the door, you're letting the heat out.

d0b6778162.speaker: zbyszek
d0b6778162.text: I'm not sure of anything. I said only Hanka writes that fair. I didn't say it was her.

d0c87af692.speaker: zbyszek
d0c87af692.text: Wojtek bets like it's somebody else's wages. Halina goes up on nothing now and then, so don't fold the first time she does.

d0cba1d4a1.speaker: jarek
d0cba1d4a1.text: She'd ask that. She used to wait at the door for her to come in.

d1323d1b63.speaker: bogdan
d1323d1b63.text: A hundred. You won't be offered it twice.

d222986d48.speaker: vesna
d222986d48.text: Will the pass stay open? The weather.

d27f95b0aa.speaker: tinker
d27f95b0aa.text: Still down. I'd be grateful for a pair of hands.

d2c919a972.speaker: zbyszek
d2c919a972.text: Thaw draughts. Twelve grosze, and I don't set the price.

d2e4cdfa20.speaker: zbyszek
d2e4cdfa20.text: Buy him one if you want him to talk. Don't buy him three.

d2f2b24826.speaker: villager_f2
d2f2b24826.text: I'll send the sledge for him when the road's clear.

d3db0a712f.speaker: villager_m1
d3db0a712f.text: I'll send the sledge for him when the road's clear.

d4361c01fc.speaker: tinker
d4361c01fc.text: Good. I've told people about that beer.

d44082044d.speaker: villager_m1
d44082044d.text: Have you seen the tinker's spoons? They're not bad.

d4411e99ae.speaker: bogdan
d4411e99ae.text: They went through the ice. It happens every winter.

d544e0a5d9.speaker: ola
d544e0a5d9.text: Over the roofs. You have to look past, they're thin in the light.

d5c30b6078.speaker: bogdan
d5c30b6078.text: If you're coming tonight, stay at the back.

d67fa9c9cc.speaker: villager_m3
d67fa9c9cc.text: Burbot want the bottom, and they want the dark.

d68665cff5.speaker: tinker
d68665cff5.text: That's the knee. It'll get me to the village, and I'll put a proper runner on there.

d71364867e.speaker: ola
d71364867e.text: Kuba doesn't know. He's never done it.

d73844fb35.speaker: vesna
d73844fb35.text: Do you know what it is?

d7d8bd4cfd.speaker: zbyszek
d7d8bd4cfd.text: I didn't count. Four. Five. I had a line out, I'm allowed to have a line out.

d8c963e1e6.speaker: zbyszek
d8c963e1e6.text: Soup, if you want it. Two grosze.

d9352f8539.speaker: vesna
d9352f8539.text: How long does one take to make?

da8c15f751.speaker: dobra
da8c15f751.text: Hand me the long one. No. The long one.

daacf7bbcc.speaker: hanka
daacf7bbcc.text: Wiesiu, I'm here. I'm sorry. I'm here.

db5fb04e88.speaker: miller_wife
db5fb04e88.text: You'll say there's no sense in it.

dbe2291ea8.speaker: sled_boy
dbe2291ea8.text: There's none. And the reeve says leave the fences alone.

dd22c19b83.speaker: villager_m1
dd22c19b83.text: They're down low. The well will freeze.

dd4289dfd5.speaker: villager_m1
dd4289dfd5.text: Agnieszka took bread out to the crossroads this morning.

de327b9b79.speaker: villager_f2
de327b9b79.text: Bogdan went out to the crossroads.

debb8b0dc4.speaker: villager_f1
debb8b0dc4.text: The Wrona girl had hare for her supper. Nobody knows whose it was.

df1dcef385.speaker: zbyszek
df1dcef385.text: Well, it's not going anywhere. I've two.

e009f13e41.speaker: villager_f2
e009f13e41.text: Have you got any tallow? I'll give you eggs. Well. One egg.

e032a69394.speaker: zbyszek
e032a69394.text: I've put out what I'm putting out for today. Come back tomorrow.

e03ce8775b.speaker: villager_m2
e03ce8775b.text: Jan's been unbearable since the goat. He said she'd be under the pines.

e06ad5aaa9.speaker: bogdan
e06ad5aaa9.text: Bring it back if you go over the pass.

e0ae545f99.speaker: jarek
e0ae545f99.text: That's good. Did she see it?

e163619227.speaker: ola
e163619227.text: Straw. I have to do the straw.

e1f37faea3.speaker: dobra
e1f37faea3.text: Nothing to make. First time in my life.

e26e79a826.speaker: tinker
e26e79a826.text: Eight grosze. I can't go lower, I pay seven.

e2ccf1d04d.speaker: bogdan
e2ccf1d04d.text: Go at night, and keep it on the bottom, and be patient. It doesn't come to a jig by day. I've tried.

e2ed8733cb.speaker: villager_m2
e2ed8733cb.text: The Wrona girl had hare for her supper. Nobody knows whose it was.

e3ac793a57.speaker: bogdan
e3ac793a57.text: Everyone's lost a line there. Jarek. The Wrona boys. Stach lost two.

e417653fa7.speaker: vesna
e417653fa7.text: There were lights over the lake when I came in.

e4a15124d9.speaker: bogdan
e4a15124d9.text: Anybody who has sat out there.

e509884b9d.speaker: goat_owner
e509884b9d.text: Where it's green. There's nothing green. My husband says there's grass under the twisted pines past the marsh, a little, where the branches keep the snow off. Don't ask me how he knows.

e517f71578.speaker: dobra
e517f71578.text: Because you don't. My mother didn't. Her mother didn't.

e6f04ac455.speaker: miller
e6f04ac455.text: Up the river, past the wheel, to the falls. There's a hollow in the rocks at the bottom.

e704b1abbf.speaker: villager_f2
e704b1abbf.text: The tinker is back at the stalls. Three years.

e71c511e98.speaker: villager_m3
e71c511e98.text: Wacław hasn't been out on the ice since that business at the river mouth.

e7b4776761.speaker: vesna
e7b4776761.text: I was in your cellar. You've been giving your own ration to the Nowak children.

e7ca4aff01.speaker: vesna
e7ca4aff01.text: That song. Do you know all of it?

e7fedc4bac.speaker: villager_m2
e7fedc4bac.text: The old woman still takes her milk out to the shrine every morning.

e8192033df.speaker: vesna
e8192033df.text: Your lips are moving. What are you counting?

e913f4a08f.speaker: ola
e913f4a08f.text: You did the mouth. At the end. Like this.

e97a959514.speaker: hanka
e97a959514.text: The wood needs splitting. She can't swing the axe.

ea61965c52.speaker: ola
ea61965c52.text: I carry the big one. Dobra said I can hold the pole.

ea6e85f435.speaker: fisher_old
ea6e85f435.text: I cut this hole. My father cut it before me, at this bend, every freeze.

ea7a9237aa.speaker: dobra
ea7a9237aa.text: My grandmother used to say it was real girls once, before the straw. I don't know. She said a lot of things.

eba5d0adff.speaker: wiesia
eba5d0adff.text: I don't want to go down there. It's dark down there.

ebdb99d03f.speaker: villager_f1
ebdb99d03f.text: I'll send the sledge for him when the road's clear.

ebe6b00de2.speaker: wojtek
ebe6b00de2.text: Zbyszek's got it chalked up behind the bar, if you can't hold it in your head.

ebf39f6cfc.speaker: villager_f1
ebf39f6cfc.text: Have you got any tallow? I'll give you eggs. Well. One egg.

ec1d131280.speaker: vesna
ec1d131280.text: Frozen bread on the table. A music box. And a girl asked if her mother sent me.

ec2c93dedf.speaker: villager_f2
ec2c93dedf.text: Did you hear it last night? Out on the lake?

ed0458d7be.speaker: miller
ed0458d7be.text: Took my dog. Near took my boy.

edaf38e4fb.speaker: ola
edaf38e4fb.text: You sing and you throw it in and you don't look. If you look she gets you.

edb030476f.speaker: dobra
edb030476f.text: Three days. Two, if nobody talks to me.

edc643b682.speaker: fisher_young
edc643b682.text: Then I'll catch nothing somewhere else.

eddcc786d3.speaker: hanka
eddcc786d3.text: There's no fire, I'm sorry. I only light it when Ola's in.

ee137c3467.speaker: zbyszek
ee137c3467.text: These have been dropped too often.

ee2325cb28.speaker: tinker
ee2325cb28.text: Marzena. I haven't been through in three years. Is Zbyszek still keeping the Bell?

ee321103fb.speaker: miller_wife
ee321103fb.text: It'll be on one of the poles. Look for the rag round the clapper. Dusk, mind.

ef67f09857.speaker: zbyszek
ef67f09857.text: Something's out there at night. I've seen it from the shore. Like people walking, but wrong. Slow.

ef7cc27fe3.speaker: vesna
ef7cc27fe3.text: I heard dice when I came in.

f02a08a66f.speaker: fisher_old
f02a08a66f.text: Thirty winters I've cut that hole.

f02f69a800.speaker: villager_f1
f02f69a800.text: Somebody found Zofia's goat in the twisted pines, past the marsh.

f04894b840.speaker: vesna
f04894b840.text: Isn't there wood nearer the houses?

f132f9727d.speaker: villager_m2
f132f9727d.text: Agnieszka took bread out to the crossroads this morning.

f16aeb3b65.speaker: zbyszek
f16aeb3b65.text: If you've got it on you.

f17d30a116.speaker: villager_m3
f17d30a116.text: They're thick over the poles. Hard frost.

f1b40fce7a.speaker: miller
f1b40fce7a.text: You put your hand in the hole there and it isn't cold like the other holes. My father did it, his father did it.

f1cba0cb5f.speaker: vesna
f1cba0cb5f.text: You said the goddess took one from this house.

f2859f39ae.speaker: halina
f2859f39ae.text: Not tonight. I'm walking down with the rest.

f32c0808a3.speaker: ola
f32c0808a3.text: There's a pink one! There's a pink one!

f3b065162b.speaker: zbyszek
f3b065162b.text: Wojtek and Halina. Middle table, every day from noon. They'd play till the candles went if I let them.

f3b3e7f545.speaker: jarek
f3b3e7f545.text: I made this. For the rite. For after. I was going to give it to her after.

f3c17827b7.speaker: bogdan
f3c17827b7.text: I've nothing to say to you.

f401628e6b.speaker: jarek
f401628e6b.text: They come to the rowan by the well. She'd stand under it an hour.

f4738b5948.speaker: wojtek
f4738b5948.text: I'll go up. Go on, match it.

f4d54763b1.speaker: miller
f4d54763b1.text: I counted four. And a big one, she stays back. Old. A scar right across the face.

f4e31660e2.speaker: vesna
f4e31660e2.text: I'm working in the village, on the ice. Out by the poles.

f5af7fd108.speaker: zbyszek
f5af7fd108.text: Go on. I have a pot on, so be quick.

f6708ae4ef.speaker: zbyszek
f6708ae4ef.text: I'm shutting at seven tonight. Everyone goes.

f696410546.speaker: hanka
f696410546.text: She drowned. Three years ago. At the rite.

f69e67769b.speaker: villager_f1
f69e67769b.text: Zofia's goat came home on a rope.

f6b2e8cc3d.speaker: vesna
f6b2e8cc3d.text: I hear you've been picked. For tomorrow night.

f6e95ae03c.speaker: bogdan
f6e95ae03c.text: A girl from the village. Same as every year.

f70eb1f579.speaker: villager_f2
f70eb1f579.text: Somebody left a hare on the Pawlak step again.

f73680a90d.speaker: vesna
f73680a90d.text: I was out at the poles last night.

f7592f6a1b.speaker: bogdan
f7592f6a1b.text: There's a place by the tower where the ice is thin. Somebody tied a rag to a stake there, years ago, I don't know who. Cut a hole there. Not wider than a bucket.

f7798e89b2.speaker: villager_f2
f7798e89b2.text: Didn't see one this morning. I'm taking the washing in.

fa7ec173d8.speaker: zbyszek
fa7ec173d8.text: Upstairs, end of the landing. Boots off.

fb800f0ef2.speaker: miller
fb800f0ef2.text: The boy came back without the bucket. He hasn't been down since. None of them go.

fc0586501f.speaker: tinker
fc0586501f.text: Up. I can't tie it from the ground.

fc547f5c1a.speaker: zbyszek
fc547f5c1a.text: Look on your way out. Low or high, that's all I need.

fc8281cf4e.speaker: villager_f1
fc8281cf4e.text: Bogdan went out to the crossroads.

fd7cd0caeb.speaker: wojtek
fd7cd0caeb.text: Six grosze on you, at least. I don't play for promises.

fd9566fabf.speaker: hanka
fd9566fabf.text: I didn't think anyone would come.

fdff3fed62.speaker: vesna
fdff3fed62.text: Tell me what it doesn't say.

fe2b9dec77.speaker: zbyszek
fe2b9dec77.text: Then you know more than I'd tell you.

fe2d093b4a.speaker: dobra
fe2d093b4a.text: I tie it the same way every time. I can't do it any other way.

fe4b6a591e.speaker: villager_f2
fe4b6a591e.text: Jan's been unbearable since the goat. He said she'd be under the pines.

fee627f7e0.speaker: vesna
fee627f7e0.text: The straw ones on the ice had red thread at the neck. All of them.

ff11cdcd03.speaker: wojtek
ff11cdcd03.text: No. I'm not paying for that.

ffb8b4c519.speaker: sled_boy
ffb8b4c519.text: It's the runner. It went in at the edge of the bank and now it won't come out. Mama says I have to be home with the wood before dark.

fffa6d2045.speaker: villager_m1
fffa6d2045.text: Have you got any tallow? I'll give you eggs. Well. One egg.
